title: Cut Done cards into named Versions
body: Implement kanban Cut. Spec (approved, amended 2026-09-16): docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-16-kanban-cut-design.md. Plan (grug-reviewed): docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-16-kanban-cut.md. Execute the plan task by task with superpowers:subagent-driven-development in hybrid mode: tasks 1-3 batched into one implementer, tasks 4-7 one each; build/test gates are the review for mechanical tasks. Update docs/kanban-board.md, CONTEXT.md, and both foreman-kanban skill copies (Task 7), not a new doc. Never stage .foreman/. Ask the user for build-screenshot after Task 6.
